answer_2.quote: Performance is measured using the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) metric... We also report F1 scores for Taxonomy Construction and Spearman correlation for HyperLex.

answer_3.quote: We also evaluate the overlap between MAG datasets with WordNet data, providing the inputs, predicted nodes, and ground truth nodes to ChatGPT, asking for preference.

answer_4.quote: We perform a detailed error analysis for all tasks using both manual and automatic approaches: e.g. we evaluate error patterns and model quality using ChatGPT.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators manually inspected model outputs and categorized error types according to predefined categories.
